messages.subject: Kmult with PCoA eigenvectors?
parts:
Dear group, 
I was wondering if it makes sense to test for a phylogenetic signal in a set of eigenvectors derived from a PCoA, which was conducted on a Gower distance matrix, calculated from a matrix with a mis of categorical and continuous traits.

Any advice? 

Thank you in advance,
Diogo

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Kmult with PCoA eigenvectors?
parts:
If one feels that Gower distance captures the data space then yes.

Dean
